name: ddd-distilled
description: Vaughn Vernon's Domain-Driven Design Distilled as a Claude Code toolkit: skills, subagents and output styles for subdomains, bounded contexts, context maps, small aggregates, event storming and DDD without ceremony.

inject_rules.title: Inject the compact rules at session start
inject_rules.description: Adds the short Domain-Driven Design Distilled rule set to every session as always-on context. Leave off when you use several book plugins; the skills load the rules on demand.
